en.headline: Lee says One Stanley steel-bar case is under investigation
en.dek: The Chief Executive said the Buildings Department is examining whether main bars match the approved drawings, and asked the Development Bureau to oversee the probe.
body: Chief Executive John Lee said on Tuesday morning that the Buildings Department is investigating the One Stanley project in Stanley, after reports that the number of main steel bars in part of the development did not match the approved drawings.

Speaking before the Executive Council meeting, Lee said he would not comment on the details while the case was still under investigation. He said the department was looking into construction quality and whether supervision had been adequate, and that any breach would be handled strictly under the law.

Lee said he had asked the Development Bureau to oversee the investigation. He also said the bureau would press ahead with work already flagged for this year: proposals to amend the Buildings Ordinance, aimed at tighter regulation and stronger penalties. He said the government treated construction quality, professional standards and safety as matters that required firm enforcement.

The project, on Wong Ma Kok Road, is a luxury housing development. Lee linked the case to a wider concern about recent construction-quality problems, but he did not name other sites or give a timetable for the One Stanley inquiry.

zh.headline: 李家超：屋宇署正調查赤柱ONE STANLEY鋼筋問題
zh.dek: 特首說屋宇署正查主鋼筋數量是否與圖則相符，並已要求發展局監督調查，違規會依法嚴懲。
body: 行政長官李家超星期二早上出席行政會議前表示，屋宇署正調查赤柱黃麻角道豪宅項目ONE STANLEY，事件涉及部分樓板的主鋼筋數量與圖則不符。
李家超說，個案仍在調查，現階段不會評論細節。他說署方正查明施工質素和監管是否到位，若發現違規，會依法嚴厲處理。
他表示已要求發展局監督這宗調查，並針對整體建築工程提升法例的規管要求和罰則，確保阻嚇力。他又說，發展局早前已表明會在今年內提交《建築物條例》修訂建議，強化監管和懲處，局方會全速推進。
李家超強調，政府重視本港建築工程的施工質素、專業水平和安全，關注相關專業人員有否盡責監督，以及承建商有否違規施工。他沒有交代調查完成時間，亦沒有點名其他地盤。
